nina-sec: Quick heads-up - restore job for `staging/snap-2026-03-24` failed: `AccessDenied: cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt` when calling KMS.

ben-sre: staging or prod? which key?

nina-sec: staging. Key: `projects/redwood-ops/locations/global/keyRings/backups/cryptoKeys/staging-key`. Restore runs as `legacy-backup@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com`.

aya-encops: Did we just run the IAM cleanup at 02:10Z? I had a note about removing unused service accounts.

ben-sre: I applied prune at 02:07Z. I intentionally skipped keys used by `backup-*` but maybe `legacy-backup` wasn't referenced in the inventory.

nina-sec: There's also a curious missing metadata case: object metadata for the snapshot in GCS doesn't include the `x-goog-meta-cmek` header when fetched through the backup proxy, but `gsutil stat` shows the header present on the object.

ci-bot: Alert: 1 failed decrypt, key staging-key, 2026-03-24T02:22:34Z. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kms-restore

aya-encops: Two hypotheses: 1) RBAC prune removed key binding for `legacy-backup`; 2) proxy path rewrites metadata during retrieval and drops cmek header on proxied GETs.

ben-sre: I re-granted decrypter role to `legacy-backup` on the key. Restore retried and succeeded.

nina-sec: Good. We need to follow up on the proxy behavior and inventory accuracy. Also audit logs show a ~6m gap for KMS admin events around the prune time.

aya-encops: For immediate hardening: add `gcloud kms keys test-iam-permissions` into the RBAC-prune job to detect active restore principals. Also have the backup proxy explicitly preserve cmek headers.

ben-sre: I'll add the test command to the prune script and back up current key policies before any change.

nina-sec: Action items: ben to update prune script + backup policies (ETA 3h). aya to patch proxy metadata handling and add object tag `uploader=v2` for visibility (ETA 4h). I'll file SEC-6005 for RCA doc.

ci-bot: Postmortem placeholder created: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/pm-2026-03-proxy-metadata-prune

nina-sec: Closing thread, will update when RCA is ready.
